# 5 Things You Need To Do Before Publishing Your Roblox Game

**Source:** https://www.instagram.com/reel/DddJLuVBjnZ/ · **Author:** shadarchives · **Saved:** 2026-10-01

## Summary

Before releasing a Roblox game, developers should polish the first five minutes of onboarding and test gameplay across all supported platforms like mobile and console. Additionally, creators need compelling visual marketing assets, a solid six-step progression loop, and thorough QA testing to identify exploits and bugs before launch.
